description: This file contains functions for extracting and validating plugin configuration settings, sections, actions, and options for a Mattermost web application, including handling React components and various setting types.

methods.name: extractPluginConfiguration
methods.description: Main function to extract plugin configuration object from unknown input, validating structure and contents.

methods.name: extractPluginConfigurationAction
methods.description: Extracts and validates a plugin configuration action object.

methods.name: extractPluginConfigurationSection
methods.description: Extracts and validates a plugin configuration section, including components and settings.

methods.name: extractPluginConfigurationSetting
methods.description: Extracts and validates individual plugin configuration settings, including radio and custom types.

methods.name: extractPluginConfigurationCustomSetting
methods.description: Extracts and validates custom component settings.

methods.name: extractPluginConfigurationRadioSetting
methods.description: Extracts and validates radio button settings with options.
